description:
Score-based multi-capacity assignment:
- Assignment: Order tasks by best score + regret (best minus second-best score); greedily assign each to its highest-scoring resource with available slots.
- Local Search: Optionally evaluate pairwise task swaps across resources; accept moves yielding strictly positive total-score improvement.
- Termination: Stop on zero improvement, time limit, iteration limit, or minimum-gain threshold.
